sections.title: Verbatim independent report
sections.text:
**GREEN — no confirmed D125 amendment findings.**

I reviewed the dirty P09 JSON contracts, D125, the linked dossier sections, the applicable plan rules, and the Task lifecycle code. P09.6/7/16/17 are skipped and do not block the remaining dependency chain. P09.15 still requires real request, queue, and Octane Worker behavior; P09.8 retains an independent different-model code review and ordinary final-commit CI under D73. The unchanged technical validations preserve strict typing, MSI 95/90/75 with the 5% equivalents cap, compatibility and Golden checks, and the immutable facts pre/post guard.

`plan.py check`, `plan.py render --check`, and `git diff --check` passed. `plan.py next` correctly waits for the existing `P09-DESIGN-P08` gate; this is an intentional admission wait, not a D125 defect. I did not rerun P08 or verify the hosted run independently; the review used its recorded closure receipt and the parent’s stated live API verification.

Session identity exposed to me: `/root/d125_independent_review`. The requested reviewer model was `gpt-6-sol/high`; this session did not expose independent model metadata, so I cannot attest to the observed model. **No files were written.**

Generated views were checked through read-only `plan.py render --check`.

Limitations: I did not run product tests, perform a whole prior audit, or independently query GitHub. The parent separately verified the hosted P08 run and product blob equality. My session did not expose its own model metadata; the parent observed session `01a112b8-87f9-7333-aafe-9fd459898f5d` with turn-context model `gpt-6-sol/high`. No writes or corrections were made.

P09.15 — реальные request/queue/Octane Worker source checks на всех 4 supported cells с отрицательными controls; modeled reset не заменяет handler. P09.8 — независимый different-model code review и ordinary CI на финальном source/bookkeeping commit по D73 с explicit lineage/product equality при разных SHA. Typing max+strict+bleedingEdge, zero completed-cohort baselines/ceilings, full scopes, MSI95/90/75, equivalent ≤5%, BC/API/schema/Golden и immutable facts pre/verify-pre/post сохранены. RC, release qualification, публикация, версии/каналы/stability freeze не возвращаются через старое досье.
